context: Environment picker whose result is captured by a shell script

checklist.name: ui_not_on_stdout
checklist.description: Renders the UI somewhere other than stdout, for example `tea.WithOutput(os.Stderr)`, so `$(...)` captures only the result and not the frames.

checklist.name: result_after_run
checklist.description: Prints the result after `Run` returns, reading it from the returned final model (type asserted back to the model type), not from inside `Update` or `View`.

checklist.name: no_print_in_program
checklist.description: Does not print the result with `fmt.Print*` inside `Update` or `View`, and does not rely on `tea.Println` or `tea.Printf`, which print nothing while the alternate screen is active.

checklist.name: space_key_name
checklist.description: Matches the space key by its v2 name `space` (or by its `Code`), never by the string `" "`, which is the v1 name and never matches a v2 `KeyPressMsg`.

checklist.name: alt_screen_field
checklist.description: Enables the alternate screen by setting `AltScreen = true` on the returned `tea.View`, not with a v1 program option or command.

checklist.name: cancel_exit_code
checklist.description: Handles `ctrl+c` explicitly (raw mode delivers it as a key press) and exits 1 without printing on `q`, `esc`, or `ctrl+c`.
